**Video 4, Light Well 4-5 at Wang Cheong House** ²⁴⁷⁰

View V4a-V4c: The fire propagated upward abruptly inside the narrow vertical gap between the kitchens of flats 04 and flats 05. At the later stage of the video, the fire burnt fiercely in the light well, and objects appeared to be bamboo member dropped from height and a paper box dropped comparatively slower (as marked in blue square), whereas suspected burning object (as marked in red circle) was lifted by the upward draught of the fire from the area near light well and then descending gradually.
